message.content: A stable latent design is a set that has levels, sizes, and channels. It has a VAE, a text level, a time level, and a signal level. The VAE maps a clean image in a latent image. The text level maps text in a signal. The time level maps time in a signal. The signal level takes a latent image, a time signal, and a text signal, and it makes a clean latent image in steps.
